# adraw

> Headless-first infinite SVG canvas engine for whiteboards and diagramming UIs. TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies, optional DOM adapter, and adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Angular and Web Components.

adraw separates a DOM-free engine from an optional SVG adapter. The engine owns
elements, selection, history, snapping, documents and validation. The DOM adapter
handles pointer, touch, keyboard and rendering. State is observed through an
immutable `AdrawStore` snapshot.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/adrawdev/adraw/blob/main/docs/agents.md) — headless workflows, documents, validation, errors and testing without a DOM.
- [Core guide](https://github.com/adrawdev/adraw/blob/main/packages/core/README.md) — tools, elements, state, history, export and CSS variables.
- [Public API inventory](https://github.com/adrawdev/adraw/blob/main/docs/PUBLIC_API.md) — the supported surface.
- [API stability policy](https://github.com/adrawdev/adraw/blob/main/docs/API_STABILITY.md) — SemVer, deprecation and breaking changes.
- [JSON Schema](https://github.com/adrawdev/adraw/blob/main/packages/core/schema.json) — `CanvasDocument` draft 2020-12.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/adrawdev/adraw/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md) — impact/effort plan.
- [Bundle budget](https://github.com/adrawdev/adraw/blob/main/docs/BUNDLE_BUDGET.md) — size limits and tree-shaking guardrails.

## Minimal headless example

```ts
import { AdrawCanvas, createRectangle } from "@adraw/core"

const canvas = new AdrawCanvas()
canvas.addElement(
  createRectangle({
    id: "rect-1",
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    width: 200,
    height: 120,
    cornerRadius: 8,
    strokeWidth: 2,
    strokeColor: "#111111",
    fillColor: "#ffd43b",
    rotation: 0,
    zIndex: 1,
    locked: false,
    visible: true,
  }),
)
```

## Rules for agents

- Do not mutate maps or sets returned by `getElements()` / `getSelectedIds()`; use the public methods.
- Prefer `updateElement`, `updateElements`, `batch`, `setLocked`, `setVisible`, `align`, `distribute`, `duplicate` and `nudge`.
- Validate untrusted JSON with `validateDocument` and migrate it with `migrateDocument`.
- Use `toDocument({ deterministic: true })` and `serializeDocument` for stable diffs.
- Branch on `AdrawError.code`; never parse error messages.
- Use explicit element ids when reproducible output matters.
- Headless text measurement is approximate; pass `measureText` for custom metrics.
- Image export (`toImage`) requires a mounted DOM adapter; serialize the document in headless runs.
